parts:
Jim,

You're going to want to do something like this:

plotdata <- merge( a, b, by=1, all=T )
library( reshape )
plotdata_melted <- melt(plotdata,id.vars=1)
library( ggplot2 )
qplot( position, value, data=plotdata_melted, geom="line", color=variable )

Regards,
Ben
